dict.string: VitalTrack AI reads heart rate, heart rate variability, and blood pressure that other apps or FDA-cleared devices already saved in Apple Health. VitalTrack AI does not estimate blood pressure from the camera.
VitalTrack AI can save blood pressure readings you enter from an FDA-cleared external monitor into Apple Health when you choose to export them.
VitalTrack AI uses the camera only for heart rate measurement via photoplethysmography (PPG). The camera does not measure blood pressure.
VitalTrack AI uses Bluetooth to connect to compatible FDA-cleared blood pressure monitors so you can import cuff readings. Bluetooth is not used to estimate blood pressure from the phone itself.
VitalTrack AI connects to external blood pressure monitors over Bluetooth to receive measurements from the cuff.
VitalTrack AI can remind you to log blood pressure from your external monitor or optionally check heart rate. Reminders are optional.
